name: f3-numeric-mldr-pilot
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun recovery-input/materialize.ts; bun recovery-input/compose.ts numeric; bun numeric-input/pilot-source.ts; result=0; bun f3-input/pilot.ts > numeric-f3.log 2>&1 || result=$?; cat numeric-f3.log; test "$result" -eq 0; bun numeric-input/pilot-source.ts numeric-f3.log; bun f3-input/audit-pilot.ts numeric-f3.log --strict-window; bun numeric-input/compare-pilot.ts numeric-f3.log
